name: Spooky Scary Nighttime Adventure
source:
Four funny teens get up to some spooky antics in the woods. Join Fawners, Basil, Skye, and Terry as they investigate some rumors about a strange family living out in the woods!

[From [url=https://lemonprophet.itch.io/spooky-scary-nighttime-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四个活宝少年在森林里搞起了惊悚大冒险！跟随福纳斯、巴兹尔、斯凯和特里，一同调查有关林中怪异一家的神秘传闻吧！

[摘自[url=https://lemonprophet.itch.io/spooky-scary-nighttime-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
